    Build the backend against pipeline v0.2.7
    
    v0.2.7 carries the pipeline half of the validation fixes this repository already
    expects: the nearest-road search covers every county near each point (the
    BG_TIGER2 cache tag was introduced for it), the CBP county fallback is chosen
    per episode, missing FARA values stay missing, and the polygon rasterization
    grid no longer depends on the cohort. Until this bump a rebuilt image installed
    v0.2.6 and recomputed under the new tags with the old search.
